cq: Which credit card transactions exist in the dataset?
sparql:
PREFIX eli: <http://data.europa.eu/eli/ontology#>
PREFIX geo1: <http://www.w3.org/2003/01/geo/wgs84_pos#>
PREFIX lkg: <http://example.org/lkg#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX ex: <http://example.org/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX schema: <http://schema.org/>

ASK {
  ?transaction a ex:CreditCardTransaction .
}

cq: What is the job of the person who made a transaction?
sparql:
PREFIX eli: <http://data.europa.eu/eli/ontology#>
PREFIX geo1: <http://www.w3.org/2003/01/geo/wgs84_pos#>
PREFIX lkg: <http://example.org/lkg#>

PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX ex: <http://example.org/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX schema: <http://schema.org/>

ASK {
  ?transaction a ex:CreditCardTransaction ;
               ex:usesCard ?card .
  ?card ex:heldBy ?person .
  ?person schema:jobTitle ?job .
}
diagnosis:
ASK returned false. Missing: ?transaction a ex:CreditCardTransaction ;
               ex:usesCard ?card .
  ?card ex:heldBy ?person .
  ?person schema:jobTitle ?job .
